notes: Posted 1 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card (its one Tatooine card is You May Start Your Landing), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'startin jizz' (a section header, not a card): Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) ('5th marker'), Prepared Defenses ('prepd def'), You May Start Your Landing ('YMSYL'), Imperial Arrest Order ('IAO') and 'secret plans (or imp decree vs drainers)'; these count toward the 60. There is no objective, so the 5th Marker is the starting location. Several Effects start and the post names none as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.

Three lines name a card with an alternative and are kept as written: 'secret plans (or imp decree vs drainers)' (starting), 'imp decree (or secret plans, whatever you didnt start)' (effects) and 'commander brandei (or admiral piett, i like the higher destiny)' (a line-wrapped name, merged). The strategy text favours Secret Plans to start, Imperial Decree in the deck and Commander Brandei ('better destiny than piett').
Section headers 'locations', 'characters', 'vehicles and one ship', 'interrupts', 'effects', 'kill ebo stuff' and '7's' are not cards.
Posted 'at at cannons' (one copy) dested AT-AT Cannon and 'blow up generators' dested the Epic Event Target The Main Generator, listed under 'kill ebo stuff' (anti-Echo Base Operations cards).

Posted 'garrison x4' dested Walker Garrison (the strategy says 'walker garrison x4'); 'much anger' Much Anger In Him (the strategy's 'RoC/Anger'); 'visage x2' Visage Of The Emperor (listed under the destiny-7 cards); 'potf' Presence Of The Force; 'executor' Flagship Executor (the deck's one ship); 'imp walker' Imperial Walker; 'blizz 2' Blizzard 2; 'commie igar' Commander Igar; 'tarkin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'cabbel' Lieutenant Cabbel; 'evax' Officer Evax; 'ds612/613/614' DS-61-2/3/4; 'dvdlots' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'op as planned' Operational As Planned; 'twilek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'mourful roar' Mournful Roar; 'Reponsibility of Command' Responsibility Of Command.
The Hoth sites ('hoth dbay', '3rd marker', '4th marker', 'war room') dested the Dark pages.
The list totals 59 as published (the post gives no section counts).
